newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian minister backs insurers' fund plan.
newsitem.headline: Belgian minister backs insurers' fund plan.

text.p: Belgian Economics Minister Elio Di Rupo said on Tuesday he would support plans for the insurance sector to set up a fund to cover natural catastrophes.

"Guidelines will be presented to the cabinet on Friday and, if it gives its backing, my administration will finalise the draft legislation," he told a parliamentary committee meeting. A text of his comments was made available by his office.

Under the plan, all household insurance premiums in Belgium will be raised by 500 to 1,000 francs ($14-$28) to constitute a fund to cover payouts on floods and other disasters, which are presently covered partially by the government and not at all by insurers.
